title: Use the Schedule Occupancy report
summary: Appointment analysis: how many were completed, canceled or no-shows, and how many ended in a quote or session.

steps.title: Menu → Reports → Schedule Occupancy
steps.details: Appointment analysis: how many were completed, canceled or no-shows, and how many ended in a quote or session.

steps.title: Period
steps.details: Today, this week, this month, last month, this year or your own range.

steps.title: Filters
steps.details: Doctor, calendar, branch, status and service.

steps.title: Generate
steps.details: Calculates the report with the chosen filters.

steps.title: No data
steps.details: There's no data for those filters: try another period.

steps.title: Indicators
steps.details: Total appointments, completed and canceled rates, no-shows, with quote, with session, average duration and unattended.

steps.title: Results
steps.details: Charts by status, day, hour and doctor, and the details.

steps.title: Details
steps.details: Sort by column by tapping the header.

steps.title: Export
steps.details: Excel, CSV or PDF with what you're viewing.
